• IndiGo Ventures invests in Sarvam as part of Series B funding round

    IndiGo Ventures, the corporate venture capital arm of IndiGo, has invested in Sarvam as part of its Series B funding round.

  • Karnataka explores voice AI for skilling, healthcare and investor assistance

    Karnataka is exploring pilot projects using ElevenLabs’ voice AI for skilling, healthcare, investment promotion, culture and citizen services. Discussions also focused on responsible AI, deepfake prevention.
